title: Oracle freshness and stale-feed recovery
status: source repair verified; capability not accepted
changes: Removed the previous-value maxAge check from updatePrice so an authorized updater can replace an expired feed.
Added isFresh and getFreshPrice; missing, future-dated, or expired values fail closed through the guarded read.
Preserved getPrice as the backward-compatible raw feed read.
A zero maxAge continues to disable expiry; the configured maximum age is inclusive.
scope_limits: The ingestion service does not yet consume getFreshPrice.
The contract update API has no source timestamp, so source-time validation is not established.
Feed consensus, service parity, live-chain behavior, deployment, and MAN-CAP-044 acceptance remain open.
No deployed contract, chain, candidate database, or legacy database was touched.
environment_note: Foundry emitted a non-fatal warning because the restricted process could not flush /Users/gilbertoadon/.foundry/cache/signatures; the test suites completed successfully.
